adversarial_findings.scenario: Cascade halt: KDS subscriber throws on receive — does OSS still update?
adversarial_findings.rationale: Backend cascade and frontend subscribers are independent — KDS JS handler exception is contained in Vue handler scope; backend outbox already broadcast to all subscribers on private-branch.{id} channel. OSS subscribes independently to same channel. Frontend cascade-halt is impossible by design — Echo fan-out is server-side per-channel.
adversarial_findings.evidence: Each Vue handler subscribes via Echo's per-component on() wrapper; exception in KDS handler does not propagate to OSS handler.

adversarial_findings.scenario: Stuck-in-flight: Order in CREATED state with no kitchen_status update for 60min
adversarial_findings.rationale: Outbox staleness monitor (MonitorOutboxStaleness.php:33-50) alerts on dispatched_at NULL > stale-after threshold. Default 30s. Threshold-crossing emits Log::error + non-zero exit (line 65). Cron + Outbox rescue (OutboxRescueCommand.php:13) re-queues stale pending events.

adversarial_findings.scenario: Ghost state: kiosk cancels but borne already at confirmation screen — drift?
adversarial_findings.rationale: Order self-cancel transitions through OrderStateMachine + lockForUpdate (OrderService:1684+1947). KioskWaitingComponent.vue:215-220 has 'offline-queued skip polling' guard; on reconnect, KioskCartComponent.vue:474 comment confirms 'kiosk missed the Echo broadcast (offline blip, app reload)' detection. Polling 15s catches missed transitions.

adversarial_findings.scenario: Concurrent bump: 2 chefs bump same item simultaneously — which wins?
adversarial_findings.rationale: KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService::changeStatus + OrderService::changeStatus both lockForUpdate-wrap inside DB::transaction (per CONVERGENCE_PHASE_K.md K2-HEAL-02 mirrors that pattern). First DB::commit wins, second sees committed state and idempotent-returns. OrderStateMachine::apply gates transitions.
adversarial_findings.evidence: OrderService.php:1947 + AppServiceProvider IdempotencyKeyMiddleware boot guard + OrderStateMachine FROZEN §7

adversarial_findings.scenario: OrderCancelled NOT in BROADCAST_MAP cascade (only OrderStatusChanged) — client receives both for admin cancel + only OrderStatusChanged for customer self-cancel
adversarial_findings.rationale: OrderCancelled IS in BROADCAST_MAP (EventContract.php:39) but NO PersistOrderCancelledToOutbox listener exists. By design — broadcast is via OrderStatusChanged (payload.new_status=CANCELED). OrderCanceled internal event drives ReleaseStock/ReleaseAvailability cascades only. Client surfaces cannot distinguish customer-cancel vs admin-cancel in the broadcast payload itself.
adversarial_findings.severity: P2 — not a sync bug; clients still see the status change. Distinction-of-origin is via order.user_id / order.user attribution at fetch time.

adversarial_findings.scenario: OrderPaymentStatusChanged broadcast emitted but no JS subscriber (K9-001)
adversarial_findings.rationale: Outbox row emits broadcast (EventServiceProvider:165-166 PersistOrderPaymentStatusChangedToOutbox), but no surface (POS/KDS/OSS/Kiosk) subscribes via onEvents broadcastAs match. Partial refund therefore silent on UI until next polling refresh. Owner brief flagged this as V1.0.X non-blocking.
adversarial_findings.severity: P1 — surfaced in CONVERGENCE_PHASE_K.md (FIND K9-001). Mitigation: per-surface polling catches state within their respective cadence (POS 5s/60s, KDS 5s/60s, OSS list() on next echo, Kiosk 15s).

adversarial_findings.scenario: Empty payload broadcast: contract violation saturation
adversarial_findings.rationale: EventContract::assertEnvelopeValid (line 99-148) + assertPayloadValid (line 155-176) drop contract-violating payloads to fiscal log channel with contract_violation: prefix; do NOT retry (line 176 comment 'payloads = 6000 useless messages saturating the high lane'). DLQ pattern prevents storm.
